attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Delaware state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per 30 Del. C. § 1102: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 6.6%. Standard deductions: $3,250 Single/MFS, $6,500 MFJ/QSS, $3,250 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Delaware Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.6%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Delaware Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.6%)" job.audit_trail swap addto swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Delaware Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.6%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 6500.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.066
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 6500.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.066 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " DE MFJ taxable income (AGI - $6,500): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " DE state tax (6.6%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
